text: ここ　さいきん　カントーでは　みたことも　ない　めずらしい　ポケモンが　つぎつぎ　みつかって　おるのじゃ！

structure.jp: めずらしい　ポケモンが
つぎつぎ　みつかって　おるのじゃ！
structure.en: are being found one after another!

patterns.name: 〜たことがない
patterns.explanation: A past verb plus ことがない says you have never done it; も in place of が adds 'even'. みたことも　ない = 'have never even seen'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after a て-form verb says the action keeps going on. おる is the old-man form of いる. みつかって　おる = 'are being found'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence sound like an explanation. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. おるのじゃ = 'you see, they are'.
